# forgo: vet folds //fgo:comptime constants and expands //fgo:macro calls
# the way the compiler does, instead of reporting "is not constant".

go vet m/clean
! stderr .

# go test runs vet on comptime packages too.
go test m/clean
stdout '^ok'

# Analyzers see the expanded macro, with the argument's own position.
! go vet m/bad
stderr 'bad\.fgo:15:\d+: fmt\.Printf format %d has arg s of wrong type string'

# A comptime evaluation failure is reported, not ignored.
! go vet m/badcomptime
stderr 'compile-time evaluation failed: .*missing\.txt'

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.27
-- clean/clean.fgo --
package clean

import (
	"comptime/embed"
	"strings"
)

//fgo:comptime
func square(n int) int {
	return n * n
}

const nine = square(3)

const greeting = embed.ReadFile("greeting.txt")

var buf [nine]byte

//fgo:macro
func twice(x Node) Node {
	return Quote(func() {
		Splice(x) + Splice(x)
	})
}

func F() int {
	return twice(len(buf)) + len(strings.TrimSpace(greeting))
}
-- clean/greeting.txt --
hello
-- clean/clean_test.go --
package clean

import "testing"

func TestF(t *testing.T) {
	if n := F(); n != 23 {
		t.Fatal(n)
	}
}
-- bad/bad.fgo --
package bad

import "fmt"

//fgo:macro
func show(format, arg Node) Node {
	return Quote(func() {
		fmt.Printf(Splice(format), Splice(arg))
	})
}

func F(s string) {
	show("%s\n", s)
	show(
		"%d\n",
		s)
}
-- badcomptime/bad.fgo --
package badcomptime

import "comptime/embed"

const missing = embed.ReadFile("missing.txt")
